name: NoroMeal
tagline: NoroMeal Replaces calorie tracking apps with personalized weekly meal plans tailored to your body, goals, and preferences
description: NoroMeal Replaces calorie tracking apps with personalized weekly meal plans tailored to your body, goals, and preferences. Instead of logging every meal, users get a full 7-day plan with macro-balanced recipes from a library of 400+ meals. Users can set their goals, adjust preferences, mark favorite or avoided foods, and swap meals with macro-equivalent alternatives — all without manual tracking or complicated logging.
